steps.text: Reported playing on the CrossOver-tree engine (highball-db#22, M5, macOS 27.0): D3DMetal rated 5 of 5 on r7, DXMT running on r8 at 26 fps in Shibuya at 1280x800 on a throttling Mac. The reporter says the Sikarugir (Wine 10) engines do not run it and that r8 loads more stably than r7, so the recipe asks for r8. Highball asks for Apple's licence the first time D3DMetal is used.

On engine r7, DXMT with the cross-process swapchain switch kernel-panicked the reporter's Mac. On r8 the reporter says DXMT works and the panic did not recur. Not measured by the maintainer, so the recipe keeps D3DMetal, the rated mode; switch the game to DXMT in Advanced if you want to try it on r8.

knownIssues.symptom: On engine r7 with DXMT and DXMT_ALLOW_CROSS_PROCESS_SWAPCHAIN=1 the whole Mac kernel-panicked (reported on an M5, macOS 27.0)
knownIssues.cause: not measured; the panic log names the watchdog timer, which is what fires when the GPU driver stops responding. The reporter says it did not recur on engine r8 with DXMT
knownIssues.fix: the recipe asks for engine r8 and sets D3DMetal, the mode the reporter rated; DXMT on r8 is reported working

knownIssues.symptom: Does not run on the Sikarugir (Wine 10) engines
knownIssues.fix: the recipe asks for engine x64-crossover26.3-r8
